name: Hotel Booking System
description: Hotel reservation database with guest profiles, room inventory, and booking records. Practice date calculations and revenue analysis.

tables.name: guests
tables.description: Guest profiles with contact info, nationality, and loyalty points

tables.name: rooms
tables.description: Room inventory with type, branch location, and pricing

tables.name: bookings
tables.description: Hotel reservations with stay duration, pricing, and booking status

relationships.description: Each booking belongs to one guest
Each booking is for one room

sample_queries.title: Revenue by Room Type
sample_queries.description: Total revenue breakdown by room type category
sample_queries.sql:
SELECT 
  r.room_type,
  COUNT(b.booking_id) as total_bookings,
  SUM(b.nights_stayed) as total_nights,
  SUM(b.total_price_idr) as total_revenue,
  AVG(b.total_price_idr / b.nights_stayed) as avg_price_per_night
FROM rooms r
JOIN bookings b ON r.room_id = b.room_id
WHERE b.booking_status = 'Confirmed'
GROUP BY r.room_type
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

sample_queries.title: Top Loyalty Guests
sample_queries.description: Most frequent guests ranked by loyalty points and booking count
sample_queries.sql:
SELECT 
  g.full_name,
  g.nationality,
  g.loyalty_points,
  COUNT(b.booking_id) as total_bookings,
  SUM(b.total_price_idr) as lifetime_value
FROM guests g
LEFT JOIN bookings b ON g.guest_id = b.guest_id
GROUP BY g.guest_id, g.full_name, g.nationality, g.loyalty_points
ORDER BY g.loyalty_points DESC
LIMIT 10;

sample_queries.title: Occupancy Rate by Branch
sample_queries.description: Calculate room occupancy percentage per hotel branch
sample_queries.sql:
SELECT 
  r.branch_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT r.room_id) as total_rooms,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN b.booking_status = 'Confirmed' THEN b.room_id END) as occupied_rooms,
  ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN b.booking_status = 'Confirmed' THEN b.room_id END) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT r.room_id), 1) as occupancy_pct
FROM rooms r
LEFT JOIN bookings b ON r.room_id = b.room_id
GROUP BY r.branch_name
ORDER BY occupancy_pct DESC;

sample_queries.title: Booking Channel Performance
sample_queries.description: Compare bookings and revenue across different booking channels
sample_queries.sql:
SELECT 
  booking_channel,
  COUNT(*) as booking_count,
  SUM(total_price_idr) as total_revenue,
  AVG(total_price_idr) as avg_booking_value,
  AVG(nights_stayed) as avg_stay_duration
FROM bookings
WHERE booking_status != 'Cancelled'
GROUP BY booking_channel
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;
